variants.prompt: A raven-haired beauty lounges provocatively on a plush king-sized bed in a lavish penthouse suite, her dark tresses spilling across crimson silk sheets. Almond-shaped emerald eyes sparkle with cultured vivacity as she gazes directly at the camera, set beneath arching brows. Her full lips, painted a subtle scarlet, curve in a confident, inviting smile. The cinematic shot captures her striking features with a DSLR's shallow focus, the bokeh of the city lights outside blurring the background.
